recorded: 2026-10-23, before any prompt ran on a scoring note
how_labelled: pre-annotated by Claude, human-reviewed: Claude pre-annotated every note under a written protocol, flagging its confidence per note; the project owner then reviewed all labels in labelling_sheet.xlsx

changed_in_human_review.source: the owner's report; the pre-annotated sheet was not kept, so the count cannot be checked from files

validated: after merging into labelling_sheet.csv: all 225 labels filled and every one is in labelling_choices.csv; the non-label columns are unchanged from before the merge

gaps: The written pre-annotation protocol is not in this repository.

The labels are not independent of the extractor's model family (Claude): agreement between Claude Haiku and these labels may be inflated by shared judgements, so the LLM's accuracy here is an upper-leaning estimate. The keyword baseline does not share this bias.
